data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Datadog logs and Real User Monitoring (RUM).
data.what_it_does: Provides bindings to Datadog mobile SDKs for logging, RUM, and crash reporting on Android, iOS, and Web. Lets you configure Datadog features and automatically tracks views and resources.
use_when: You need Datadog analytics, logging, or RUM in a Flutter app
You target Android, iOS, and/or Web and want a single plugin for all platforms
avoid_when: You prefer a lightweight, platform‑agnostic logger
You are not using Datadog as your backend
data.setup_notes: iOS: use_frameworks! and target >=13.0; Android: minSdkVersion >=23; Web: add Datadog CDN scripts to index.html; optional HTTP tracking via firstPartyHosts
